name: openspec-superpowers-workflow
description: Six-phase feature development workflow that enforces strict role separation between OpenSpec (WHAT to build) and Superpowers (HOW to build). Prevents common anti-patterns like modifying specs during code review, patching specs incrementally instead of clean rewriting, and mixing cross-cutting constitution rules into feature specs. gate-check.cjs decides whether Phases 1 and 2 stop for the user (Phase 3 and the Phase 6 rewrite no longer wait). Two PreToolUse hooks turn the skip decision (a declaration file) and the archive step (a fresh reconcile-check pass) into machine checks; tasks.md is the execution record.
